description: This file performs post-build operations in a build script, including copying static assets, setting up runtime aliases, and orchestrating the build steps for a plugin runtime environment.

methods.name: listStaticExtensionAssetOutputs
methods.description: Returns the list of destinations for static extension assets, sorted alphabetically.

methods.name: copyStaticExtensionAssets
methods.description: Copies static extension assets from source paths to destination paths, creating directories as needed, and warns if assets are missing.

methods.name: writeStableRootRuntimeAliases
methods.description: Creates or updates alias files in the distribution directory for runtime assets matching a specific naming pattern.

methods.name: runRuntimePostBuild
methods.description: Orchestrates the post-build steps by copying metadata, setting up runtime aliases, and copying static assets.
